ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a plant, with a sun icon in the upper right. Label D is located in the upper right of the plant, near the sun, and next to it there is a curved arrow pointing from the direction of the sun toward the plant leaves. Reasoning: In diagrams of plant growth or photosynthesis, an arrow from the sun toward the plant usually represents light energy entering the plant. Therefore, stage D shows light energy.
